'''House Blackthorn''' is the house of '''intellect''': he who thinks further wins over he who strikes harder. The battle is won before it is fought; patience is the highest virtue, and to be surprised is the only true shame.

== Philosophy and reputation ==
Blackthorn children are raised on deliberate contradiction and learn to love being contradicted — ''"The one who loves you tells you where you're wrong."'' The house studies defeats more than victories. Its reputation across the realm is double-edged: feared on the battlefield, never quite respected as rulers; the realm remembers brilliant, impossible victories that somehow never became lasting power.

== Customs ==
* '''The Objection''' — an annual gathering at which the head of house's plan must be attacked by everyone present. Silence is an insult.
* '''The Defeat Library''' — a collection of failures, kept to be learned from. Its most famous archivist, [[Halden]], stopped writing abruptly and disappeared.

== The seat ==
[[Thorn Hall]] has no straight wall to storm: a sprawling, disorienting complex woven into the landscape, with gates that lead astray and false main courtyards. The defense is design, not walls. A black-thorned bush grows only here; it cuts whoever grabs it too hastily.

== Members (396 A.U.) ==
* '''[[Alder Blackthorn]]''' (~58), head of house — the most skilled living tactician.
* '''[[Wren Blackthorn]]''' (~29), elder heir — the sharp mind without the caution.
* '''[[Corin Blackthorn]]''' (~24), younger son — the purest mind in generations, without the will to rule.
* '''[[Maeve Torn]]''' (~45) — raised in the hall, Alder's right hand; loyal, though not by blood.
